title: Require review records on reviewed profiles and close builder residuals
status_note: Blocked from done until the verifier updates its own profile fixtures. Its three files write reviewed profiles with no review record, so 33 of their tests now fail on the new G2 rule alone. I was not to edit those files.

changes.G2_default: New _check_profile_review in build_dataset_release.py, run before any read. A profile marked reviewed or approved needs a top-level review mapping with a nonempty string reviewer and an ISO8601 reviewed_at string with a timezone. An unquoted YAML timestamp is refused and the message asks for quotes; PyYAML would otherwise produce a datetime that is not JSON. scope is optional, but if given it must be a nonempty string. When scope is absent, a limitation is recorded: "The profile's review does not state a scope, so what its ranges were checked against is unknown." Profiles with no status (legacy) are unaffected.
changes.R1: _publish_files_exclusively now unlinks every staged name before the final destination hash check, not after.
changes.R2: For reviewed or approved profiles, an applicability block whose keys are only task and/or task_id is refused ('Applicability must name more than the task ...'). This runs after the existing applicability-gap check and before the review-record check.
changes.R3: New _profile_review_line on the data card. Reviewed or approved: '- Profile review status, as declared by the profile: <status> (<reviewer> at <reviewed_at>; scope: <scope or not declared>). The builder did not verify this review.' Legacy: 'as declared by the profile: none (recorded as legacy_unspecified)'. No profile: 'not applicable; no profile was supplied'.

committed_profiles: No range profile in the validation ranges folder declares review_status, so G2 and R2 newly refuse none of them. All stay legacy_unspecified, with their existing limitation.
